work.objective: Independently make the Bun/OpenTUI /help dialog reconciler-safe and height-aware at 80x24, with a visible help footer, Esc close and Ctrl+C exit; leave real PTY proof exclusively to the independent verifier.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths for every read, search, edit and command.
Only modify the four allowlisted help/dialog files; do not modify Ink, renderer dispatch, dependencies, lockfiles, Marshal state, commit, push, publish, use network access or start subagents.
Implement independently from the frozen base; do not read, list, compare, import or copy any previous help Marshal worktree, patch, transcript, WorkerResult, ReviewPacket or run artifact.
Use only child composition supported by the real @opentui/react reconciler; TextNodeRenderable must receive supported span/text children.
Keep the footer visible at 80x24 by bounding or scrolling shortcut content independently of the footer; do not hide required footer text.
Do not optimize component structure for raw ANSI byte contiguity: OpenTUI may emit cursor/style sequences between adjacent visible words. Preserve the semantic visible phrase and URL.
Worker checks are limited to OpenTUI vitest, CLI typecheck/build and git diff --check; do not launch Bun, expect, PTY diagnostics or background processes.
Keep this a native help correctness fix; no broader visual redesign.
If an operation is denied, do not retry that path; use an allowed equivalent or report blocked.
context: The base can crash /help with TextNodeRenderable child-type errors and can push the footer below 80x24.

Real OpenTUI output positions styled text runs with ANSI sequences, so native evidence matches the visible footer words across renderer control bytes instead of demanding contiguous raw terminal bytes.
The independent verifier waits for ready, sends /help, observes the visible For … more help: footer at 80x24, sends Esc, then Ctrl+C and requires EOF without critical errors.
Preserve slash gateway, command processing, mouse behavior, prompt behavior and layout outside the help dialog.
